high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article headline and the first paragraph from a news article. The headline reads: "Parking trouble awaits private jets on way to Ayodhya." Below the headline, it states that the article is a 3-minute read and was published on January 13, 2024, at 12:09 AM IST by Anu Sharma and Mihir Mishra. The text in the article discusses the issue of parking for private jets flying to Ayodhya for the inauguration of the Ram temple. It mentions that about 50 jets are expected to land at Ayodhya airport
